name: Axiata Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Axiata 推进 edotco 基础设施业务的重大重组：拟出售 edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited 全部股权给 OCK Sea Towers，出售 edotco Towers Pakistan 全部股权给 Osiris Global，并拟出售 edotco Group 约15.645%股权以及 edotco Towers, Inc.、PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia 和 edotco Bangladesh 全部股权。同期，集团继续派发股息并寻求股东对经常性关联交易的授权。
overview_en: In 2026, Axiata pursued a major restructuring of its edotco infrastructure business: proposed disposal of its entire equity interest in edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited to OCK Sea Towers, disposal of its entire equity interest in edotco Towers Pakistan to Osiris Global, and proposed disposals of approximately 15.645% equity interest in edotco Group as well as entire equity interests in edotco Towers, Inc., PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia and edotco Bangladesh.

segments.name: 基础设施
segments.note: 今年 edotco 基础设施业务进行多项股权出售，涉及 Labuan、Pakistan、Indonesia、Bangladesh、Philippines 及 edotco Group 部分股权。
segments.note_en: This year the edotco infrastructure business carried out multiple equity disposals involving Labuan, Pakistan, Indonesia, Bangladesh, the Philippines and part of edotco Group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟由 edotco Group Sdn Bhd 向 OCK Sea Towers Pte. Ltd. 出售 edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited 全部股权，以现金支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal by edotco Group Sdn Bhd of its entire equity interest in edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited to OCK Sea Towers Pte. Ltd., to be satisfied entirely in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟由 edotco Investments (Labuan) Limited 向 Osiris Global Limited 出售 edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited 全部股权，以现金支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal by edotco Investments (Labuan) Limited of its entire equity interest in edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited to Osiris Global Limited, to be satisfied entirely in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟出售 edotco Group Sdn Bhd 约15.645%股权、edotco Towers, Inc. 全部股权、PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia 全部股权及 edotco Bangladesh Co. Ltd. 全部股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of approximately 15.645% equity interest in edotco Group Sdn Bhd, entire equity interest in edotco Towers, Inc., entire equity interest in PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia and entire equity interest in edotco Bangladesh Co. Ltd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited 全部股权，退出该公司。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of the entire equity interest in edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited, exiting the company.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited 全部股权，退出巴基斯坦铁塔业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of the entire equity interest in edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited, exiting the Pakistan tower business.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 edotco Group 约15.645%股权及 edotco Towers, Inc.、PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia、edotco Bangladesh 全部股权，缩减 edotco 基础设施业务版图。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of approximately 15.645% equity interest in edotco Group and entire equity interests in edotco Towers, Inc., PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia and edotco Bangladesh, reducing the edotco infrastructure business footprint.
